reason: The cited lines show Puppeteer-style file selection/upload via `handle.uploadFile(...filePaths)` or `fileChooser.accept(filePaths)`, not arbitrary host code execution. They do not show host file contents or other non-public data being returned into the agent context, so SECRET is not supported. The file upload/accept operation can make the selected file data available to the browser page, which is a sink to a potentially attacker-readable destination. The optional `response.includeSnapshot()` indicates returning page snapshot content, which can be attacker-controlled, so UNTRUSTED is supported.
